summary: OKYO Pharma Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing its presentation at the H.C. Wainwright 6th Annual Ophthalmology Virtual Conference scheduled for July 22, 2026. The filing is a routine current report by a foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16, providing notice of a corporate presentation event and incorporating the report by reference into its existing F-3 registration statement. No transaction, strategic action, or special situation is announced; the document merely discloses a conference participation. It is equivalent to a Form 8-K Item 7.01 disclosure of investor events.
